description:
About our brand and products

Wild Mountain Child creates eco friendly, wonder filled sensory play resources inspired by nature and childhood imagination. Our PlayFizz sensory bases are hand made in small batches, naturally coloured, non toxic and filled with botanicals and treasures that spark curiosity. Our Wild Tree Tools are ethically crafted in a traditional Vietnamese craft village and designed for open ended play that feels grounded in nature. Everything we create is intentional, sustainable and made to support slow, meaningful play for children aged two to nine.

What makes us different

We are a values driven small business that cares deeply about the environment, childhood magic and ethical production. Our packaging is biodegradable or home compostable. Our colours come from nature. Our tools are fair trade certified and support traditional craft communities. We design every product with purpose and we put the wellbeing of children and the planet at the centre of every choice.

How affiliates can earn

Our affiliate program rewards you for sharing products you genuinely love. You will receive a unique affiliate link that tracks your referrals. When someone uses your link to make a purchase, you earn a commission on every qualifying order. It is simple, transparent and designed to support small creators, educators and parents who want to partner with a brand that aligns with their values.

How to promote us

You can promote Wild Mountain Child in any way that feels authentic to you and your community. This can include Instagram posts and stories, reels, blog features, product reviews, unboxings, play setups, Pinterest pins or warm recommendations in parent and educator groups. Share your genuine experience, show the products in action and talk about why you love them. Natural storytelling always works best.

Other information

We welcome people of all audience sizes and backgrounds. You do not need to be an influencer. You only need a love for nature connected play and an audience who appreciates slow, sustainable childhood experiences. Affiliates receive ongoing support, seasonal ideas, product updates and early access to launches. Our aim is to build a community of aligned voices who believe in imaginative play, sustainability and childhood wonder.
